summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed a Rule 424(b)(5) resale prospectus on October 14, 2026, registering 366,162 shares of common stock held by selling stockholders, which were issued as consideration in a June 2026 acquisition. The company will receive no proceeds from resales; shares may be sold at prevailing market prices. OPTT last traded at $2.12 on September 22, 2026. This is a routine resale shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for potential share overhang from future selling stockholder dispositions.
